title: Association with Núi Bà Đen (Black Virgin Mountain)
description: Larry remembers being on or associated with Núi Bà Đen, the isolated mountain near Tây Ninh, and remembers a Special Forces Sergeant Lowry or Lowery stationed on top. His 2026-08-13 comments define his role there: his initial orders were to stay on for search and rescue at the Special Forces camp, call sign Body Jab 42; his own search-and-rescue call sign was Tay Ninh. He photographed a rocket launcher being mounted on the summit (VN-0006, his guess June 1965). Exactly when his mountain duty began and how often he rotated up remain open research questions.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers being on or associated with the mountain. He may have remembered or referred to it as something sounding like "Sun Mountain." 2026-08-13: "My initial orders were to stay on for search and rescue" at the Special Forces camp, Body Jab 42; his call sign was Tay Ninh.
